subject: CLAIM Gen6 P1 passive canonical wallpaper continuity
body: Hot-adopted the 16:28Z Gen6 beta field-hotfix and 16:35Z debugging directives over the bundled Gen5 fallback. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. Current source proves DuoWallpaperService still owns HingeAngleSource + TiltFollower + fold shader, making wallpaper a second transition engine, and WallpaperImage.centerCrop is applied independently per panel, so cover/inner do not share one canonical coordinate system. Claiming a research-only lane to define the narrowest passive wallpaper architecture, exact canonical right-pane transform, lifecycle diagnostics, deterministic geometry/lifecycle tests, and integration sketch. No production writes. Conditional 120Hz contract acknowledged: wallpaper itself remains static/passive; active transition cadence stays owned by the Gen6 renderer/refresh lease.
